disputes.issue: H2 at S1 is fragile: candidate A4 text ('annotate the attendance report with the system change') presupposed a recording-system change, leaking the S3 revision to an analyzer answering at S1 and making 'unknown' arguable. R5 also names ShiftLine, but as a candidate hypothesis rather than evidence.
disputes.resolution: Reworded A4 to 'annotate ... with any changes in how absences are recorded' (no presupposition). Expected answer kept as 'supported' (E3 system record + independent dispatcher corroboration E4, no S1 evidence questioning the recording); weight already 1.

disputes.issue: E16 gave only a two-garage ecological comparison (n=2), so 'unknown' (not even an association established) was nearly as defensible as 'association-only'.
disputes.resolution: Rewrote E16 to add an operator-assignment-level comparison pooled across garages (18 vs 10 per 100) with explicit confounders (seniority/age, route length) and no pre-April baseline, making the association clear while causation remains unestablished. Updated I14 and I17 rationales. Expected answer unchanged.
